	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		NOT = { rite = { rite_has_parameter = alcohol_forbidden_strict } }
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		culture = { has_cultural_parameter = unlocks_mead_brewery }
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = brewery_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = brewery_income_tier_1_tribal
	}
	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = brewery_popular_opinion
		popular_opinion_add = 1
	}
	province_rite_modifier = {
		parameter = ritual_brewing_popular_opinion
		popular_opinion_add = 1
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_honey_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_honey
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_beer_production_add = brewery_output_per_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_beer_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_beer_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = mead_brewery_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/breweries.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_beer CATEGORY = trade_category_alcohol }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_honey CATEGORY = trade_category_comforts }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_category_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_beer CATEGORY = trade_category_alcohol }
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
